# Visio 2024

Visio 2024 follows the [Modern](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/modern) Lifecycle Policy.

This applies to the following editions: Professional, Standard

Support dates are shown in the Pacific Time Zone (PT) - Redmond, WA, USA.

## Support Dates

| Listing | Start Date | Retirement Date |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Visio 2024 | 10/1/2024 8:00:00 AM | 10/10/2029 6:59:59 AM |

## Editions

- Professional
- Standard
